title: NASA TechRise Challenge
field: Science and technology experiments for test flights
about: The NASA TechRise Student Challenge invites student teams in grades 6-12 to propose a science or technology experiment for a NASA-supported test flight. A teacher or school employee submits proposals via Future Engineers. Winners are expected in January 2027, with flights in summer 2027.
card_alt: Card for the NASA TechRise Challenge by NASA, United States, for student teams in grades 6-12; proposals due 2 Nov 2026. The background is the default city skyline photo.
